Geometry: airfield start/end/width from the dynaf composit definition.

note: Extracted offline from aces.vromfs.bin (dynaf_* composit geometry: airfield start/end/width + spawn points) and mis.vromfs.bin (mission placement TMatrix). x = world east, y = world north/Z, metres. altM is absolute world altitude (m), not AGL. Every record carries the exact `level` it belongs to; no name matching was used. No airfield geometry exists in levels/dover_strait.bin itself.
